Metadata.Title: The Santa Saga: A personal target
Metadata.Description: This mission is a little personal Agent 47,Morgan Flemming  is fortunately working with known muderer Santa Claus, and I've had a vendetta against him when he called my Anime trading card Game cringe. Him and his 4 assosiates must be taken out if we don't want to lose Santas trail after we lost him in paris.
